invariants.rationale: The method always initializes 'ids' and returns it, throws otherwise.
Regardless of encoding, 'ids' is always sized to 'width * height'.
Negative width would produce an invalid array size; exception would be thrown if so.
Negative height would produce an invalid array size; exception would be thrown if so.
The method accesses fields and methods of 'element' without any null check, so it must be non-null.
